units.source_text: 明治“文明开化”的痕迹之一，至今仍保留着的沿护城河行驶的北野线电车，终于决定要拆除了。

en.t: The Kitano Line streetcar, one of the traces of Meiji-era civilization and enlightenment that still remained running along the moat, was finally set to be removed.

units.source_text: 这是日本最古老的电车。

en.t: It was the oldest streetcar in Japan.
